description: Execute a product search with filters, sorting, and pagination.

in_stock.description: Optional filter to only return in-stock products

rating_min.description: Optional minimum average rating filter; valid range 1–5

seller_ids.description: Optional list of seller IDs to restrict results to

brand_ids.description: Optional list of brand IDs to restrict results to

attribute_filters.description: Optional structured attribute filters for precise product matching

attribute.description: Name of the product attribute (e.g. color, battery_life_hours)

operator.description: Comparison operator: eq (equals), in (one of), or range

value.description: Filter value; a scalar for eq, an array for in, or an object with min/max keys for range

geo.description: Optional geographic proximity filter for location-aware product listings

date_range.description: Optional date range filter applied to a specific date field

field.description: Name of the date field to filter (e.g. created_at, updated_at)

sort_by.description: Sort order: relevance, price_asc, price_desc, rating, or newest

include_facets.description: If true, include facet aggregations in the response; defaults to false

facets.description: Optional fine-grained facet configuration; takes precedence over include_facets when provided

fields.description: List of fields to aggregate facets for (e.g. brand, price_range, rating)

max_values_per_facet.description: Optional maximum number of values to return per facet field

boost.description: Optional list of field-value boost rules to promote certain results

field.description: Field name to match for boosting

factor.description: Score multiplier; values greater than 1 promote, less than 1 demote

personalization.description: Optional personalization signals to tailor search ranking for the requesting user

user_id.description: ID of the user; used to load browsing history and preferences

use_history.description: Whether to factor in the user's past browsing and purchase history

use_location.description: Whether to factor in the user's current location for proximity ranking

spell_check.description: Whether to attempt spell correction on the query string; defaults to true

synonyms_enabled.description: Whether to expand the query using the configured synonym dictionary; defaults to true

highlight.description: Optional configuration for query-term highlighting in search result snippets

enabled.description: Whether to return highlighted fragments in results

fields.description: List of fields to apply highlighting to

fragment_size.description: Optional maximum character length of each highlighted fragment

locale.description: Optional BCP47 locale used to localise prices, dates, and sort behaviour (e.g. en-US)
